description_en: The apartment is located in the New Ring area, in Astir, near Kafe Santanna, a developed and sought-after residential area, with easy access to main roads and numerous services. Information about the apartment: • Typology: 1+1 • Floor: 2 • Net area: 57.6 m² • Gross area: 66.3 m² • Orientation: North-East • Regular mortgage documentation Interior organization: • Living room + kitchen area • 1 Bedroom • 1 Toilet with window • Closed balcony Advantages: • Quality investment and furnishing • Very good area for living • Natural lighting throughout the day • Functional layout • Ideal for living or investment
